content.text: {"issues":[{"where":"Research Question 1 — Hermia model fits on two years of logged batch data","problem":"Hermia blocking model fitting requires flux-time curves at controlled, constant TMP; the logged batch data are operational records under varying conditions, not controlled filtration experiments, so the model fits cannot be validly derived from them alone.","fix":"Restrict Hermia model fitting to controlled bench-scale experiments in Phase 1 and use the two years of logged data only for qualitative trend analysis and foulant hypothesis generation."},{"where":"Phase 3 — inline CIP endpoint monitoring using conductivity and UV absorbance","problem":"The plan assumes the company UF skid has inline permeate-side UV absorbance and conductivity sensors, but the company records list no such instrumentation and the term sheet does not include their provision.","fix":"Add to Phase 3 a step in which the university supplies or the company installs the required inline sensors before pilot trials begin, or replace inline monitoring with grab-sample analysis if installation is not feasible."}],"unconfirmed":[]}
